newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen steady.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.04 down at 41.47 to the dollar in the kerb market on Wednesday amid high demand for the U.S. currency and is likely to open steady on Thursday, dealers said.
They said the demand for the dollar improved after it fell sharply against the rupee in the past few sessions.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on July 11, was 40.5200/40.7226 against the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.30 percent compared to Tuesday's close at 2.35 percent.
